items.note: S2.1 states the exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with every scratch wire restored for arbitrary initial values, but calls the stages 'three forward stages' where the paper uses forward, inverse, forward (731-733). The schedule, neighbour rule, h, N, m and the cancellation (JV+RG)x=x are not given; it is an infer step with no derivation.

S2.2 gives the invariant (stored = D_v applied to logical), the commuting of a common frame with a pointwise gate, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and that only the edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} cost anything. This matches 804-825. It is a one-line inference, not a derivation.

S2.3 correctly gives the triple pairings (|S∩T|-1 over Q, |S∩T| mod 2 over F_2), orthogonality of neighbours and nondegeneracy. S2.4 gives nested labels with only central-wire edges decreasing, but omits the loss h per edge, L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and the ratios L/N=100/539 and 101/539. S2.4 also jumps directly to s<Wm.

S2.5 states the endpoint difference I_m on every role, the shear H<-H+D and s=Wm-N+2L<Wm, quoting the deficit N-2L_b>0 (1167). The projection assignments P_U and -P_{U_a} that produce these are not given, but the statement is faithful.

S4.1 says the frame differences are products of translation kernels aI+bX_v and that the network gives C^{⊗m} on every role. It omits that there is one kernel per orthonormal residual vector, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, and the diagonal corrections and undoing of the exchange that the C^{⊗m} result needs (1225-1227).
The plan states s<Wm, with the bit deficit N-2L>0, and a 'fixed τ<1'. It never gives L<N/2 (L/N=100/539), the deficits η_b and η_c, the inequality s/W<m^τ, or the value τ=σ=1-2^{-50} from log m<20.

S1.1 and S1.2 give O(V) splitting, merging and digit permutations, and controlled offsets and unit scalings modulo q^b. They omit the cyclic row split into W streams (item 4 of the lemma), which the recursion uses, and S1.2 drops the condition that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time, though the quote carries it.

S3.2 is correct: exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V). S3.1 omits that E_1 and E_2 are invertible, which the shear construction needs (1423, 1430). The three-update trick that makes each pivot one interchange is not shown, and neither is the choice of the prime q.

S3's method follows the paper's route: run the bit network on row streams, pay each edge in smaller interchanges, solve the recurrence. S3.3 gives F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) => O(Ve^τ). Missing: the condition s/W<m^τ, the row-field divisibility by W^k, the conversion of the shear H<-H+D into an interchange by D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D (1535-1541), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule that keeps the node overhead O(V).

S3 and S3.4 state the O(Vu^τ) interchange of two arbitrary u-bit chunks, obtained by padding and splitting off high digits. The base-m decomposition of widths and the padding of ranges to q^e are not detailed.

The plan gives H_0=bSCS and s child calls on f=e/m axes. It omits the binary change of basis P_M that puts kernels on coordinate slots, the single forward child per inverse kernel ((C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^fZ^{⊗f}C^{⊗f}Z^{⊗f}) and the layer identity H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D.

S4.2 gives the mechanism, a constant number of whole-chunk cyclic shifts followed by repair of a bounded exceptional set, as at 1947-1949. It omits δ_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} and the cost O(V(L^τ+1)). I am unsure whether this is more than a mention, so the statement is graded conservatively.

S4.3 gives s child calls each on 1/W of the volume, node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)) and the result O(Vd^{λ'}). It does not write the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) or the leaves at e<d^β. It also omits the rows taken from the first q_0 chunks, the base-m pieces and the condition on λ'. Its 's' is not identified as s_c.

The statement is faithful: Q_p(Hz) with error <√2 2^{-p} in O(Vd^{λ'}), with exact Gaussian dyadic evaluation using O(d^{C_1}) guard bits and one truncation. The sub-steps follow the paper's components. The method wrongly calls the recursion a 'bit-network recursion' (it is the complex network's), and the guard-width recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and the row preprocessing are missing.

Correct: the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{τ-1}+ℓd^{λ'}]), the signed-shift roots, the DIF rounds with output at rev_a(j), and the layout at a common offset. The exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, the error √2ℓ2^{-p} and character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I are missing. The layout's prefix-slot moves and chunk exchanges are only alluded to.
S6.1 gives evaluation at 2^{4p}, four integer products by the established multiplier and centered read-back, matching the lemma. Its cost, log(rp) per normalized unit, appears in B's total.

Correct: the route (forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise signed-packed products, opposite transform, scale by M), the normalization F^+F^-=I/M, the permutation commuting with pointwise products, and the error √2M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p}. The error accounting (2δ+η, then 3δ+η) is asserted, not derived, and S6 itself gives the error loosely as 'about 3ℓM2^{-p}'.

Correct: P_sF_s=2^{2α^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions and time O(tp^{3/2+δ}α), and the tensor form RF_s=2^γB_0QF_tA with linewise errors <dp^2. Missing: the definitions of P_s and P_t, the precise hypothesis θ=t/s-1>p/α^4 (only 'large enough') and the axis-exposure cost O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)).

S7.4 correctly gives F^+_sR=R^{-1}F^+_s and the result (u*v)/S^2. S7.3 describes Bluestein as phase, convolution with the chirp a, phase, but gives no formula for a and no identity QF_tu = ā·(a*(ā·u))/T.

Correct: the sizes b, p=6b, d=⌊b^ε⌋, T, r, t_i∈{r/2,r}, the prime window (1-2η)t_i<s_i<=(1-η)t_i, T/2<S<T and the n^{o(1)} search. Missing: η=1/(4d), α and γ, and the fixed rational exponents other than κ (τ, λ, c, λ', ε, δ).
D2.2 states Φ: x->∏x_i^{μ_i} as an isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution, realized by triangular controlled shifts. μ_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular digit formula are not given.
Multiplying coefficient k by ζ^k with ζ=e^{πi/r} maps C[x]/(x^r-1) isomorphically onto C[y]/(y^r+1), turning negacyclic wrap into cyclic wrap, as in the paper.

D2 and its sub-steps follow the paper's flow: Φ, two source transforms with exact counterpart RF_s, pointwise product, opposite transform, rescale, round, carry. D2.5 says 'rescale by S and 2^{2b+4}' where the paper's second scale is 2^{2b+4}S (4521-4522), giving S^2 in all. The input scaling 2^{-b-2} and F^+ by conjugation are not stated.

The final bound 448b2^{-b+γ}<=448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, unique rounding into [0,2^{3b}) and carries below 2^{2b} match the paper. The error chain (E_s=9·2^γTL, E_w<28·2^γT^2L) and the use of γ<=b/4 are not shown.

Correct: the seven normalized costs, min g_i=2^{-181}=2κ, and absorbing powers of log p into p^κ to reach O(n(log n)^{1-κ}). The margin formulas are not given (e.g. that g_2=εc(1-τ) is the minimum), nor are setup and prime search being o(V) or the schoolbook cutoff.
S0 relies on 'nlogn-conjecture' and its motivation alludes to beating n log n. No step states the lower-bound formulation or that the bound refutes it.

errors.says: three forward stages send (X,Y) to (-Y,X) and restore every scratch wire
errors.paper: the second stage is the inverse forward schedule from Y to X (X<-X-Y); only stages 1 and 3 are forward invocations from X to Y

errors.says: because the only decreasing edges are the central-wire edges, the total rank s satisfies s<Wm
errors.paper: s<Wm needs the loss of h per central edge (L=Ich), the extra N source ranks, and L/N=100/539<1/2 so that the deficit N-2L is positive; that only central edges decrease does not by itself give s<Wm
E_1,E_2 are invertible lower-triangular rational matrices; invertibility is what the shear construction uses

errors.says: method: express the tensor power through the complex phase network and bit-network recursion on e=mf axes
errors.paper: the layer recursion is driven by the complex network with s_c child calls on slots of f=e/m axes; the bit network enters only through the chunk interchanges used by packed row additions

errors.says: rescale by S and 2^{2b+4} to obtain the integer coefficient convolution (D2.6.1 likewise: 'scales S and 2^{2b+4}')
errors.paper: multiply first by S and then by 2^{2b+4}S, giving S^2 in all to undo the normalization (u*v)/S^2

chain: The tree follows the paper's architecture: stream primitives, the scalar exchange network, frames, labels, the bit interface, then the matrix shear and recurrence for the interchange; then the phase network and packed additions for the layer, the transforms and convolution, resampling with retained permutations, and assembly, exactness and cost. The central saving thins at S2.4/S2.5. The plan asserts s<Wm and the deficit N-2L>0 without the per-edge loss h, L=Ich or L/N=100/539<1/2, and it never derives τ=1-2^{-50}. The interchange recurrence also omits the three-shear swap and the depth-first schedule. Downstream steps are mostly stated, with partial derivations.

steps.note: Present: the exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) restoring every scratch wire for arbitrary initial values, and h=100 implicitly via triples of a 100-element set. Missing: the banks indexed by triples, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3. The stages are also misdescribed as three forward stages.
S2.2 gives the common frame commuting with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and that each edge pays only the change D_vD_u^{-1}.

Present: nondegenerate nested labels in an m-dimensional space and only central-wire edges decreasing. Missing: the loss of h on each such edge and the timing 3->4. This is close to a reconstruction, but the defining quantity h is absent.

The plan speaks of the 'total rank s of edge changes' and residuals but never says rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U. It does not mention the N rank-one source exceptions (2P_{U_a}), though s=Wm-N+2L implicitly includes them.
S2.5 states s=Wm-N+2L. The dimension budget Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are not given, so the budget's origin is not reconstructed.
The deficit N-2L>0 appears only in S2.5's quote. The ratio L/N=100/539 (or 101/539) below 1/2, which is the reason for it, is absent.
S2.5 states endpoint matrices differing by I_m on every role, giving the shear H<-H+D. The P_U and -P_{U_a} assignments are not given, but the identity and its role are.

S3.1 gives A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, S3.2 gives exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and S3 and S3.3 say the network makes s calls in all (one smaller interchange per unit of rank). S3.1 omits invertibility of E_i.

S3.3 states children of volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) => O(Ve^τ). Missing: the condition s/W<m^τ, the value τ=1-2^{-50}, and its justification from η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20. The recurrence is reconstructed but the exponent is not.

central.summary: The plan has the frame mechanism (C2), the endpoint identity (C7) and the rank-to-recursive-calls step (C8), and it states the recurrence. It asserts rather than reconstructs where the strict saving comes from: the per-edge loss h, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the ratio L/N=100/539<1/2 and the explicit exponent τ=1-2^{-50} are all missing. So the chain from network to power saving is named end to end but thin in its quantitative middle.
